/* Formatted on 10/1/2026 12:25:52 PM (QP5 v5.362) */
  SELECT RAWTOHEX (T.TERMINAL_ID)
             AS TERMINAL_ID,
         RAWTOHEX (R.REQUEST_ID)
             AS REQUEST_ID,
         R.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
         R.REQUEST_DATE,
         TP.REQUEST_TYPE_NAME,
         RAWTOHEX (M.MERCHANT_ID)
             AS MERCHANT_ID,
         M.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
         M.CIF,
         M.MID,
         T.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID,
         CASE T.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID
             WHEN 1 THEN 'POS'
             WHEN 2 THEN 'POC'
             WHEN 3 THEN 'UPG'
             ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
         END
             AS TERMINAL_TYPE,
         TSR.TID,
         CASE WHEN TSR.TID IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'GENERATED' END
             AS TID_STATUS,
         T.CREATED_AT
    FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL T
         JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST R
             ON R.REQUEST_ID = T.REQUEST_ID AND NVL (R.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
         JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT M
             ON M.MERCHANT_ID = R.MERCHANT_ID AND NVL (M.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
         LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_TYPE TP
             ON TP.REQUEST_TYPE_ID = R.REQUEST_TYPE_ID
         LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL_SYSTEM_REGISTRATION TSR
             ON     TSR.TERMINAL_ID = T.TERMINAL_ID
                AND TSR.SYSTEM_CODE = 'SMV'
                AND NVL (TSR.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
         JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_STATUS ST
             ON ST.STATUS_ID = R.STATUS_ID AND ST.STATUS_CODE = 'ST_APPROVED'
   WHERE NVL (T.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
ORDER BY T.CREATED_AT DESC
